ingredients.tip: Optional, but makes the sauce glossy

steps.text: Boil the noodles one minute shy of their package directions. Save a mug of cooking water.
Mash the miso, butter, soy, sugar, and egg yolk into a smooth paste.
Toss the hot noodles through the paste off heat, loosening with cooking water until glossy.
Twirl into bowls and finish with scallions, sesame, and enough chile oil to wake you up.
